semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Rhenium Alloys, Inc. supplies critical components like quartz infrared lamps and rhenium heater filaments to Epitaxial and MOCVD equipment manufacturers, which are essential for semiconductor fabrication.
summary: Rhenium Alloys, Inc. manufactures refractory metals and high-temperature products, focusing on rhenium, molybdenum, and tungsten-rhenium materials. In the semiconductor industry, they supply quartz infrared lamps and rhenium heater filaments to major Epitaxial and MOCVD equipment manufacturers, serving as an OEM for companies like ASM, Veeco, AMEC, and Emcore.
capabilities: Quartz infrared lamps for semiconductor equipment
Rhenium heater filaments for MOCVD and Epitaxial equipment
Refractory metal products including wire, rod, and sheet
OEM components for major semiconductor equipment manufacturers

regional_presence.United States: Headquartered near Cleveland, Ohio, with a focus on serving major semiconductor equipment manufacturers.
